2607.22434.title: Robot Learning to Communicate through Projected Visual Abstractions
2607.22434.paper_summary: Humans routinely communicate through abstractions of their bodies, including shadows, silhouettes, and reflections. Yet robots remain largely confined to expressing themselves through their physical morphology. Enabling robots to communicate through such projected visual abstractions requires reasoning not only about bodily motion but also about how that motion is transformed into an external representation perceived by an observer. Among these abstractions, shadows provide a particularly compelling example because they emerge directly from the robot's embodiment while remaining visually distinct from the body itself. Here, we present a robotic system capable of dynamic shadow expression using a 21-degree-of-freedom dexterous hand with compliant soft skin and a learned shadow self-model. The soft-skinned embodiment reduces light leakage to produce visually continuous silhouettes, while the differentiable self-model learns the mapping between hand configurations and projected shadow appearance through task-agnostic self-exploration. Given a target shadow image or video, the robot optimizes its hand configurations through gradient-based search over 1 the learned self-model and refines the solution through collision-aware simulation to obtain physically feasible motions. For dynamic shadow performance, we further introduce expressive-region objectives, temporal smoothness regularization, and keyframe-based optimization to preserve visually important motion cues while reducing optimization complexity. We demonstrate robotic shadow expression across sign-language gestures, hand-shadow puppetry, and animal motion imitation in both simulation and physical experiments. These results establish a framework for enabling robots to manipulate projected visual abstractions of themselves for communication and visual storytelling.
2607.22434.paper_summary_zh: 人類經常通過身體的抽象表達進行交流，包括陰影、輪廓和反射。然而，機器人仍然主要限於通過其物理形態來表達自己。使機器人能夠通過這些投影的視覺抽象進行交流，需要不僅考慮身體運動，還要考慮這種運動如何轉化為觀察者所感知的外部表徵。在這些抽象中，陰影提供了一個特別引人注目的例子，因為它們直接來自機器人的具身性，同時在視覺上與身體本身保持明顯的區別。在這裡，我們展示了一個能夠動態表達陰影的機器人系統，該系統使用一個具有21個自由度的靈巧手，配備柔性軟皮膚和學習的陰影自我模型。柔性皮膚的具身性減少了光漏，從而產生視覺上連續的輪廓，而可微分的自我模型則通過與任務無關的自我探索學習手部配置與投影陰影外觀之間的映射。給定一個目標陰影圖像或視頻，機器人通過對學習的自我模型進行基於梯度的搜索來優化其手部配置，並通過考慮碰撞的模擬來細化解決方案，以獲得物理可行的動作。為了實現動態陰影表現，我們進一步引入了表達區域目標、時間平滑正則化和基於關鍵幀的優化，以保留視覺上重要的運動線索，同時減少優化的複雜性。我們在模擬和實體實驗中展示了機器人陰影表達在手語手勢、手影木偶戲和動物動作模仿方面的應用。這些結果建立了一個框架，使機器人能夠操控自己投影的視覺抽象以進行交流和視覺敘事。
